about_the_game:
In the neon streets of Neo Seattle, being a hero isn’t just a vocation, it’s a cut-throat industry!

Despite being on the grind for nearly two years, professional hero Wishbright is still looking for her big break. At least until her agency hatches a scheme: pair her up with another Scout in a fake relationship to drum up press and interest!

Does Wishbright have what it takes to navigate fake love and real stakes for the sake of her dream? It would certainly be easier if co-stars were not so complicated. Not to mention the enigmatic Eclipse constantly showing up to thwart Wish’s attempts to climb the charts.

With the annual Scout convention approaching, time is running out to reach the top. But in Neo Seattle, everyone has a secret — whether it's an agenda, identity, or city-shattering truth. Will Wishbright become the Number One Scout, or is her star destined to burn out?

Our Full Release will Include:

  • 15-20 Hours of Gameplay (May increase)

  • Over 200k of script

  • 5 Romanceable characters whose routes span hero work and civilian life

  • Nameable female protagonist

  • Additional Features

    • VISUAL NOVEL STANDARD FEATURES:  Skip to Choice, Gallery, Quick Save & Quick Load, Additional Settings options. 

    • GLOSSARY: Lore Dictionary

    • PHONE: An in-game phone that can be used to chat with characters, interact with social media and more!

    • GALLERY: View Past CGs

  • And More!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: i5 6600k
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Can you top the Scout charts of Neo Seattle? Take control of unranked hero Wishbright’s fate as you fake-date your choice of star-powered personalities. Uncover secret identities, question the ethics of capitalism, and maybe fall in love in this queer, citypop-styled visual novel!
